backend/main.mo: Defines chess piece types, board structures, and movement validation helpers for various pieces, plus an initial board generator.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence entries describing required corrections to learning examples and runtime validation logic.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides prewritten summaries of all frontend source files for reference.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and a full light/dark color variable theme for the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/PUBLISHING.md: Step‑by‑step checklist for building and deploying the Chess Assistant to the Internet Computer.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes, theme provider, and global toasts for the app.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Renders a simple footer with attribution and a heart icon.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Header with logo, navigation buttons, and a share menu supporting WhatsApp and clipboard copy.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Wraps all pages with header, footer, and main content via React Router’s Outlet.
Chat input area with textarea, send button, and Enter‑to‑send behavior.
frontend/src/features/chat/ChatMessageLi: Scrollable message list showing user and assistant messages with auto‑scroll and avatars.
frontend/src/features/chat/ChatView.tsx: Implements the main chat UI, managing message state, sending user queries, and displaying assistant responses.
frontend/src/features/hosting/HostingVie: Displays hosting details, showing how the app is served on the Internet Computer and the current deployment URL.
frontend/src/features/learning/Chessboar: Renders a visual chessboard with piece symbols and highlights squares involved in the last move.
Defines structured chess learning examples, including positions, moves, and explanations for concepts like castling and en passant.
frontend/src/features/learning/exampleVa: Contains logic for validating chess example steps by checking piece movement rules and reporting errors.
frontend/src/features/learning/LearningV: Provides an interface for selecting and stepping through chess learning examples with validation feedback in development mode.
frontend/src/features/learning/MoveStepp: Adds navigation controls for stepping through example moves and selecting steps from a move list.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor using the user's Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context for Internet Identity authentication, loading stored identities and exposing login/logout methods.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines react-query hooks to fetch chess rules and en passant explanations from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useRulesAssistant.ts: Implements a rules assistant that matches questions to predefined topics and optionally enriches answers with backend data.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and custom CSS variables for light and dark chess-themed color palettes.
frontend/src/lib/rulesTopics.ts: Contains structured chess rule topics with keywords, answers, and optional backend-linked fields for enrichment.
frontend/src/lib/share.ts: Provides safe browser-only utilities for sharing the app via WhatsApp and copying the app URL to the clipboard.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders the root component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins using CSS variables for theming.
project_state.json: Defines the chess assistant project's current architecture, features, issues, and versioned state, including requirements for chat, rules engine, learning mode, hosting help, and WhatsApp sharing. Notes build failures and requests corrections to example moves.
